ValidationRule.description: Subscription Opportunities: moving on from Proposal to Contract or Closed Won requires Invoice Terms. Moving back or to Closed Lost is not blocked. Honors the On/Off Switch.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Setup.On_Off_Switch__c.Run_Validation_Rules__c && BEGINS(RecordType.DeveloperName, "Subscription_") && ISCHANGED(StageName) && ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Proposal") && ( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Contract") || ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won") ) && ISBLANK(TEXT(Invoice_Terms__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before moving on from Proposal, please complete Invoice Terms.
